assistant_model: Emotion Aware Voice Assistant configured backend (Groq GPT-OSS 120B; Groq Whisper large-v3-turbo for Spoken SQuAD audio)
task_sampling_rule: Retain the original fixed-seed 25-case pilot and add 30 randomly sampled cases per dataset with seed = 20261030 + sum(ord(character) for character in task name).
public_repository_scope: Aggregate reports, metric formulas, task summary, and the LibriSpeech aggregate summary are published. Full source datasets, source manifests, raw case-level JSONL, evaluation WAV files, and model weights are not included.
metric_caveat: SOVA-style task-family sample; not a full SOVA-Bench reproduction. Exact-match, token-F1, and ROUGE-L are lexical proxies. Published baseline values are references and were not rerun.
